simple.meaning: שְׁבִיעִי (shᵉbîyʻîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “seventh.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 98 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 2:2. Its contexts include mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁבִיעִי (H7637).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שְׁבִיעִי (shᵉbîyʻîy) / H7637 is traced through Genesis 2:2, Genesis 2:3, Genesis 8:4, Exodus 12:15 as a generated source-based concept entry.
